description: NaSb₂H₂OF₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one O and five F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.45 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.30 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four F atoms. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.30 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Sb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Sb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Sb atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Sb atom.
